data.title: Update Email Preferences
data.intro: Follow these steps to manually customize your email preferences for HWL notifications.

steps.title: Access Email Preference settings
steps.body: From the HWL menu on the left under the Settings tab, select ‘Email Preference’.

steps.title: Customize job title subscriptions
steps.body: Select ‘Job Titles Subscribed’ to add job title selections. If you want to access all available titles, click the ‘Default to Select All Job Titles’ button from the top right. Skip to later steps if Job Titles are defaulted.

steps.title: Select specific job titles
steps.body: From the subscriptions page, click ‘Select Specific Job Titles’.

steps.title: Add a job group
steps.body: From the ‘Job Title Selection’ notice, click ‘Add Job Group’. Then, from the ‘Job Group’ drop-down menu, select appropriate options, and click ‘Add’.

steps.title: Verify job title subscriptions
steps.body: A number will populate in the ‘Job Titles Subscribed Box’ indicating the total number of job title subscriptions. The added job groups will also appear under the ‘Select Specific Job Titles’ button, with numbers showing subscriptions per job group listed.

steps.title: Update notification types from the Email Subscribed tab
steps.body: Move to the ‘Email Subscribed’ tab to specify notification preferences. Depending on what actions you may take in the system, determine the notifications you want to enable.

steps.title: Set email preferences
steps.body: From the list on the left, modify the desired email notifications. Items marked in green WILL be sent via email, while those marked in gray will NOT be sent.

data.title: Set HWL Email Preferences to Default
data.intro: Follow these steps to automatically subscribe to all available notifications and job titles.

steps.title: Open Email Preferences
steps.body: From the HWL menu on the left under the Settings tab, select ‘Email Preference’.

steps.title: Set email preferences to default
steps.body: From the right, select ‘Default to Select All Emails’.

steps.title: Confirm the selection
steps.body: Select ‘OK’ to the pop-up message. Email preferences will be set, marked in gray, but a flashing red ‘All Emails Selected by Default’ indicates preferences are set.

steps.title: Set job titles to default
steps.body: Move to set Job Titles Subscribed by clicking ‘OK’ to the pop-up message. Then select ‘Default to Select All Job Titles’.
